long_biography.plain_text:
Mars, Incorporated began more than a century ago when Frank Mars sold confectionery from his kitchen, later developing into a privately held group spanning snacking, food and petcare. Marijke Elizabeth Mars represents the fourth generation of family ownership. She inherited an estimated stake after her father died in 2016 and now serves on the company's board.

Her role is governance rather than daily management: Mars has long been led by non-family executives. Marijke was identified as the company's chairperson and a director in 2023. She also serves without compensation as a director of the Virginia Cretella Mars Foundation, a separate philanthropic role from both the corporation and the inherited shareholding that underpins her wealth.
